    Restricted linear Yoneda modules #

    For a linear functor J : P ⥤ C, restriction of the contravariant representable C(-, X) to P is a covariant linear module on Pᵒᵖ. Bundling these restricted representables functorially in X is the formal core of the Bongartz--Gabriel recovery functor

    C ⟶ mod(P), X ↦ C(-, X)|_P.

    This file only constructs the functor and its finite-dimensional restriction. Full faithfulness and essential surjectivity are the substantive Auslander- category assertions and are deliberately not assumed here.
